'''Sienar Design Systems''' ('''SDS''') was a short-lived subsidiary of [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]], the predecessor to [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].

==History==
Sienar Design Systems (SDS) focused on experimental technologies and unique starship designs. SDS was [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar's]] pet project and operated in secret, working in hidden laboratories scattered throughout the galaxy. SDS manufactured the [[Scimitar/Legends|Scimitar]]<ref name="Vehicles" /> for [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] based on a design by [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Rugess Nome]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> Although Raith Sienar denied any involvement in the ship's design or manufacture, [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]] shut SDS down due to intense scrutiny from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galacitc Republic]].<ref name="Vehicles" />

At some point in the company's history, they also produced the [[Stealth ship/Legends|Stealth ship]] for the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="CWEGS1-2">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]''</ref>
